observations: Photo 0 shows a tall, red metal cabinet with multiple shelves.
The shelves are filled with various plastic bottles, some containing liquids, others empty or wrapped in plastic.
The top shelf has a row of white plastic molds or trays with curved shapes, possibly for ice blocks.
The cabinet appears old and worn, with rust and dirt visible on the metal frame and shelves.
There is no visible machinery, compressor, or control panel inside or outside the cabinet.
The seller claims to build an ice block making machine, but the photo shows only a storage unit with bottles and molds, not a functioning machine.
